documents.title: OpenTelemetry Demo documentation
documents.text: The OpenTelemetry Demo is a microservice application used to demonstrate telemetry instrumentation, collection, and visualization.

documents.title: OpenTelemetry Demo feature flag scenario
documents.citation: OpenTelemetry Demo feature flag scenario, docs@2026-09-13
documents.text: The feature flag scenario demonstrates evaluating a flag and observing the resulting application behavior through telemetry.

documents.title: Incident Lens evidence guidance
documents.text: A bounded investigation should compare logs, metrics, and traces in the same time window, preserve missing-signal warnings, and avoid treating a release timestamp as causal proof.

documents.title: OpenTelemetry observability primer
documents.text: OpenTelemetry describes observability as asking questions about a system from the outside. Instrumentation emits traces, metrics, and logs, while reliability should be considered from the user's perspective.

documents.title: OpenTelemetry signals concepts
documents.text: OpenTelemetry groups telemetry into signals including traces, metrics, and logs. Each signal provides a different view of system behavior and should be interpreted with its context.

documents.title: OpenTelemetry instrumentation concepts
documents.text: OpenTelemetry instrumentation can be supplied by libraries or application code. The choice depends on the information and control needed to observe the application.

documents.title: OpenTelemetry Collector
documents.text: The OpenTelemetry Collector provides a vendor-neutral way to receive, process, and export telemetry. It can centralize handling such as retries, batching, encryption, and sensitive-data filtering.

documents.title: OpenTelemetry Collector components
documents.text: Collector pipelines are assembled from receivers, processors, exporters, connectors, and extensions. Components handle distinct stages of receiving and transforming telemetry.

documents.title: OpenTelemetry Demo architecture
documents.text: The Demo is composed of services written in different languages that communicate over gRPC and HTTP. Its Collector configuration and service instrumentation are part of the architecture reference.

documents.title: OpenTelemetry Demo telemetry features
documents.text: The Demo instruments services with traces and selected metrics and logs, sends telemetry to a Collector, and exposes data in separate observability backends.

documents.title: OpenTelemetry Demo services
documents.text: The Demo service reference describes checkout orchestration and supporting services such as cart, payment, shipping, and product catalog, helping investigators map request flows.

documents.title: OpenTelemetry logging specification
documents.text: OpenTelemetry's log model is designed to work with existing logging systems while improving correlation. Trace and span context and resource information can connect logs with other signals.

documents.title: OpenTelemetry metrics specification
documents.text: The OpenTelemetry metrics specification defines the data model and instruments used to record measurements. Metrics are aggregated observations and require an explicit time range and context for interpretation.

documents.title: OpenTelemetry tracing specification
documents.text: The OpenTelemetry tracing specification defines spans and trace context for representing work across services. Trace context propagation lets investigators relate operations in a distributed request.
